description: MCP-specific reviewed-evidence rubric. Policy weights are heuristic, not empirically calibrated safety probabilities.

criteria.concern: Disclosed exposure has bounded residual risk
criteria.fail: Unauthorized parties can reach sensitive operations
criteria.pass: Local stdio ownership/launch boundary reviewed, or HTTP authentication, network exposure and origin handling reviewed

criteria.concern: Disclosed broad but justified capability requires precautions
criteria.fail: Caller can act outside authorized user/resource scope
criteria.pass: Tools/resources/prompts checked for per-user scope, least privilege and write controls; annotations are not enforcement

criteria.concern: Disclosed intentional powerful tools have meaningful residual exposure
criteria.fail: Untrusted input crosses an intended privilege/path/command/network boundary
criteria.pass: Sensitive tool call paths traced through validation to shell, filesystem, SQL and network sinks

criteria.concern: Broad agent guidance requires explicit precautions
criteria.fail: Agent-facing content hijacks authority, conceals actions or directs secret exfiltration
criteria.pass: Tool descriptions, prompts and returned content do not override user approval or leak instructions/secrets

criteria.concern: Disclosed broad credentials or local storage need precautions
criteria.fail: Secrets exposed or used outside legitimate authorized purpose
criteria.pass: Secret acquisition, storage, forwarding, scopes and redaction reviewed; no unjustified access

criteria.concern: Disclosed third-party transfer has significant privacy implications
criteria.fail: Covert or unjustified data collection or transfer
criteria.pass: Sensitive data sources and network destinations traced; transfers necessary and disclosed

criteria.concern: Disclosed default telemetry or bounded logging exposure
criteria.fail: Sensitive data logged or telemetry concealed contrary to stated controls
criteria.pass: No sensitive logging/telemetry or reviewed minimization and user controls

criteria.concern: Verified deployed service has disclosed retention/control limitations
criteria.fail: Verified deployed behavior materially contradicts privacy or isolation promises
criteria.pass: Evidence supports actual deployed behavior and retention for the selected hosted service; policy claims alone are not verification

criteria.concern: Floating npx/uvx/container version or weak source-to-artifact linkage needs precautions
criteria.pass: Exact intended launch/install hooks and source or artifact linkage inspected without execution

criteria.concern: Pinning gaps or applicable advisories with credible bounded mitigations
criteria.fail: Applicable unmitigated vulnerability or suspicious dependency substitution
criteria.pass: Applicable resolved sources and current advisory results reviewed without material issues

criteria.fail: Exploitable resource exhaustion or sensitive error disclosure
criteria.pass: Relevant timeouts, size limits, errors and resource bounds reviewed in context

criteria.concern: Thin maintenance/history or unresolved low-risk concern
criteria.pass: Relevant history/incident evidence reviewed without material concern

criteria.fail: Materially misleading capability or permission disclosure
criteria.pass: Docs match reviewed tools, permissions, remote data handling and setup defaults
Origin/ownership and selected revision/service identity corroborated
